title: Use iPATH3 on uproc outputs
author: Alise J Ponsero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.u3neyme

steps.title: Visualize Uproc protein hits in iPATH3
steps.instruction: Create a map of protein hits from a single Uproc output using the iPATH3 portal.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the iPATH3 portal and select 'Tools' from the top of the screen.
Upload the 'FILE_NAME.kegg.counts' input file from your computer (note: pfam28 annotation cannot be used).
Set the following parameters: Field separator to 'comma', Customization parameter to 'width' (optionally customize the line width range in 'Line width' fields), and set 'Ignore unknown IDs' to 'yes'.
Select 'Microbial metabolism in diverse environments' for the 'Visualize on map' option.
Customize the color and opacity of the pathway map in the fixed values section.
Click 'Visualize in iPATH' to generate the map.
Interact with the map by zooming in/out or clicking on pathway edges to open the 'Detailed information' window for reactions, pathways, and enzymes.
Review the 'Selecting Matching' window to analyze Hits, Indirect hits, and Conflicts for submitted IDs.
Export the customized map via the 'Controls window' by selecting 'EXPORT' and choosing the desired file format.

steps.title: Extract KEGG IDs from Uproc counts
steps.instruction: Convert the Uproc 'kegg.counts' output into a list of KEGG IDs using a bash script.

substeps.instruction: Download the 'kegg.counts' file from the Cyverse datastore to a local directory.

Run the following bash command sequence, replacing placeholders with actual paths and filenames:
DOWNLOAD_DIR=“Path/to/Your/Download/directory”
cd $DOWNLOAD_DIR
LIST=“Name_of_your_uproc_file.kegg.counts”
OUTPUT=“Name_of_your_uproc_file.kegg.list”
cat $LIST | while read LINE ; do
IFS=', ' read -r -a array > $OUTPUT
done

steps.title: Compare protein hits between two samples
steps.instruction: Visualize the overlap and differences in protein hits between two samples using the iPATH3 ID overlap tool.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the iPATH3 portal, select 'Tools', and choose the 'ID overlap' tool.
Paste the KEGG ID lists (generated from the bash script) into the ID list inputs.
Configure the color and width of the pathways for each list and the overlapping hits.
Select the 'Microbial metabolism in diverse environments' map for visualization.
Interact with the resulting map to analyze the hits.
